newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo Nobel buys Borden unit.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel buys Borden unit.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Friday it had acquired the resin impregnated papers operation from U.S. chemicals and plastics group Borden.
The unit, which is based in South Carolina, has annual sales of about 25 million guilders and 35 employees.
Akzo said the unit comprised foils and edgebanding. It will become part of Akzo's business unit Industrial Products which operates under the name of Casco Products.
Resin impregnated papers are a surfacing material for wood based board.
Casco Products' impregnated papers unit has production facilities in Canada, France, Malaysia, Germany, Spain and Sweden.
